_README: What the public repo gets from this archive repo (open-source plan, #552).
04_tools/export_public.py reads this file. Default deny: every tracked path
must match a rule, or the export fails. Rules are tried in order and the
first match wins, so each exception sits above the folder rule it carves
out of. Every rule says why.
overlay: files under this folder export to the repo root at the same
relative path, so the public README, CONTRIBUTING and the rest replace the
internal ones, which stay private. An overlay file may land on a private path
only when that path is on overlay_replaces; anything else is a clash.
